mapper.select: select cast(d.id as char) document_id, s.name, s.tax_id from documents d join suppliers s on s.document_id = d.id where d.type = 'SUPPLIER' and d.approval_status = 'APPROVED' and d.deleted = '0' order by s.name, d.id
select from documents d join purchase_orders p on p.document_id=d.id join suppliers s on s.document_id=p.supplier_id where d.id=#{documentId} and d.type='PURCHASE_ORDER' and d.deleted='0'
select * from purchase_order_lines where order_id=#{orderId} and is_current='1' order by line_no
select count(1) from documents where id=#{supplierId} and type='SUPPLIER' and approval_status='APPROVED' and deleted='0'

select count(1) from sys_user u join sys_user_role ur on ur.user_id=u.user_id join sys_role r on r.role_id=ur.role_id where u.user_id=#{buyerId} and u.status='0' and r.status='0' and r.role_key='purchaser'

select count(1) from sys_user u join sys_user_role ur on ur.user_id=u.user_id join sys_role r on r.role_id=ur.role_id where u.user_id=#{userId} and u.user_id<>#{excludeId} and u.status='0' and r.status='0' and r.role_key in('supervisor','purchasing_supervisor','purchase_supervisor')
mapper.update: update purchase_order_lines set is_current='0' where order_id=#{orderId} and is_current='1'

update purchase_orders p join documents d on d.id=p.document_id set p.supplier_id=#{supplierId},p.buyer_id=#{buyerId},p.expected_date=#{expectedDate},p.amount_cents=#{amountCents},p.tax_cents=#{taxCents},p.total_cents=#{totalCents},p.remark=#{remark},d.revision=d.revision+1,d.update_time=#{updateTime} where p.document_id=#{documentId} and d.revision=#{revision} and d.approval_status in('DRAFT','RETURNED') and d.deleted='0'

update documents set approval_status=#{approvalStatus},current_node=#{currentNode},current_version=#{currentVersion},revision=revision+1,update_time=#{updateTime} where id=#{documentId} and revision=#{revision} and approval_status in('DRAFT','RETURNED') and deleted='0'

update documents set approval_status=#{status},current_node=#{currentNode},revision=revision+1,update_time=#{updateTime} where id=#{documentId} and type='PURCHASE_ORDER' and approval_status='IN_REVIEW' and deleted='0'
mapper.select: select id from document_versions where document_id=#{documentId} order by version_no desc limit 1
mapper.update: update number_sequences set next_value=next_value+1 where document_type='PURCHASE_ORDER' and business_date=#{businessDate}
mapper.select: select next_value from number_sequences where document_type='PURCHASE_ORDER' and business_date=#{businessDate}
select id,flow_type,version,supervisor_candidates,finance_candidates from workflow_configs where flow_type=#{flowType} order by version desc limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into version_attachments(version_id,file_id,name_snapshot,sha256) select #{versionId},f.id,f.original_name,f.sha256 from document_attachments a join attachment_files f on f.id=a.file_id where a.document_id=#{documentId}
